name: BTC Funding-Time Drift
description: Tested whether BTC drifts predictably around the 8-hourly perpetual-swap funding settlement (00:00, 08:00, 16:00 UTC), which the Kalshi 15-minute market would not price. It doesn't: no drift or vol bump at those times in either half of the development data.
hypothesis: Perp holders on the paying side of funding close before the 00/08/16 UTC snapshot and reopen after, so BTC spot drifts with the perp premium's sign into and out of those times; Kalshi quoters price those windows like any other. Wrong if the premium-signed 15-minute drift before/after funding times isn't significant in both halves (Dec-Apr, May-Aug), looks the same at other hours, or is below ~0.1 sigma.
next: Rejected at research (funding_drift.py). Revisit only with OKX funding-rate history, and only if a large signed effect is plausible.
